title: Part Twenty-Five: The Records the State Already Holds

sections.brief: Data matching defined; GAO-21-183 (34 sources: 13 federal, 14 state, 7 commercial); The Work Number (CFPB; Warren-Wyden-Sanders 2 Feb 2026: half of states, price rises, 'a big positive', Arkansas 18,000); OBBBA Medicaid 80 hrs from 1 Jan 2027 (not delayed as of 5 Oct 2026), SNAP work rule 18-64; SNAP demand (May 2025, 27+ states, SAVE, June 2025 routine use; Chesney TRO Sept, PI 15 Oct 2025, expanded 26 Feb 2026); Medicaid after 29 Dec 2025 (7 Jan overshare, 30 Apr warning, May pause, Palantir via Teams, purge, re-sent, Sept hearing category by category); TANF (Boasberg PI denied 28 Sep 2026, notice in force 30 Sep); If it were connected. Figures: flow, compare

FERPA and the law-enforcement-unit carve-out (ED FAQs; camera video); Flock school cameras (The 74, Alvin ISD 733,000 searches, 620 immigration, 30 agencies); Gaggle/GoGuardian/Securly (AP/Seattle Times 2025; Lawrence suit Aug 2025); SLDS (2005-, P-20W, up to $20m); FAFSA (no sharing documented) and DOGE access to Education systems (GAO-26-108192); SEVIS (Palantir search training 2020; 1,800+ terminations reversed 25 Apr 2025; link de28); If it were connected. Figures: compare

E-Verify (IIRIRA 1996; SSA/DHS records; mismatch and 10-day contest) and the 6,300 SSA death-file entries (link de30); The Work Number and FCRA employment screening; CFPB Circular 2024-06 (24 Oct 2024) withdrawn 12 May 2025; continuous vetting (all clearance holders Oct 2021, 3.8m+, criminal/terrorism/financial/public records; NSPT rollout 2024) and NBIS (GAO-26-108838: $2.4bn + $2.2bn, alerts 30k to 100k+/quarter, 2028); Army PDE to Palantir W519TC26F0058 ($3.68m to 15 Nov 2026, sustains existing system); Gabbard 37 revocations (19 Aug 2025); law-firm EOs struck down, D.C. Cir. argued 14 May 2026; If it were connected. Figures: flow, compare

Credit bureaus and FCRA 1681f government carve-out; credit header via CLEAR (renewed 31 Mar 2026) and the NCTUE utility precedent; Fiscal Service hub, EO 14249 (Do Not Pay, Privacy Act matching waivers, SORN updates, health records excluded) and OMB M-25-32 safeguards; Treasury-Palantir common API layer (22 Sep 2025, no scope); Treasury Offset Program (notice, 120 days, limits, $10.4bn FY2020), student loans (9.3m in default; 16 Jan 2026 pause; garnishment planned); FinCEN border GTO ($200, 30 ZIPs, 11 Mar 2025; Ninth Circuit 13 Jul 2026; reissued 2 Sep 2026 $1,000 TX/NM to 1 Mar 2027); If it were connected; part's worst-case test. Figures: money
